title: The Rough Provision
author: Vesper Eriksen
blurb: Tamsin Okonkwo, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
